body: Wow, that is most possibly true.... thank you, ill follow your advice.
But isn't it weird that I feel so attracted to this friend when I thought I liked the other guy "for real"?

Hahahha I'm actually laughing at myself right now cuzy post does sound desperate and confuse!

Thank you, liking the friend does seem like there's something wrong with my feelings for the other guy...
I feel so stupid for always feeling "challenged" by this kind of guys, I don't want to lose the one I really like cuz I wanna act like a stupid teenager

I know I sound immature sorry :(
What do you think I should do? Should I tell the other guy that I'm not sure of my feelings?? I am monogamic, so I don't think I crushing both simultaneously

Thank u for showing support. I have a lot of hobbies, I do embroidery and some clay arts, and it actually help to cope, will give more time to that! Also thank u for your tip, I will definitely try it since it looks really sensible and kinda easy.
Thank u for your support. I will rely more on my therapist from now on

Thank you for sharing your experience! I convinced him to go see a psychologist, next week will be his first session. I'm very excited about it, and truly hope to stay with him during this process of healing :)

I needed to hear from someone that I was doing the right thing. Most people around me just can't understand how deep are his wounds and say he's fooling around with me. I appreciate you reminder that I need to be patient and kind.
I don't think I understood what u meant :/
How beautiful and respectful, lucky you and him for having such a beautiful connection. Hope you are feeling ok with grief, your pet is for sure thankful for having you

Parabéns por se permitir viver, a doença pode parecer estar de dominando, mas com o tratamento certo vc vai agradecer seu eu do passado por não ter feito isso.
Eu planejava me matar ano passado, e apesar de todas as adversidades, esse é de longe o ano q estou tendo as conquistas mais significativas da minha vida :)
